group.title: A supplier voicemail
group.passage: F1: Hello, this is Alice Park from Glen Packaging, returning your call about the printed paper sleeves. We can produce the quantity you requested, but the blue ink in your sample is a custom color that takes five working days to obtain. If you can approve a standard blue from our online chart, we can keep your original delivery date. I've emailed you a link to the chart and marked the two shades closest to your sample. Please discuss them with your designer and let me know your choice by noon tomorrow. Also, the artwork file you sent is clear enough for printing, so there is no need to send a larger version. You can reach me at extension forty-two.
